name: Den'ai Kanojo ~Sashuu o Sugite mo Kimi to Itai~
original_name: 電愛カノジョ ～サ終を過ぎてもきみといたい～
source: A university student named Aizawa Souta spends his days escaping his boring reality by playing a VR game with a beautiful character named Luce. One day, she appears to him outside of the game and pleads with him to have sex with her because the game is on the verge of being shut down due to lack of users. Luce has convinced herself that if the game emphasizes sexuality, it will attract more players. Luce turns to Souta, who she thinks is knowledgeable and experienced in this area, but in reality, he is not, and has never had any experience with women besides what he has learned from games and manga. Despite his lack of real-life experience, Souta agrees to help, but things take an unexpected turn.
translation: 大学生Aizawa Souta平日靠玩一款VR游戏逃离乏味的现实，游戏中的美丽角色Luce让他着迷。一天，Luce突然出现在游戏之外，恳求Souta与她做爱，因为游戏即将因玩家不足而停服。Luce认定，只要突出游戏的色情内容，就能吸引更多玩家。她觉得Souta熟悉这方面的知识，于是向他求助；但事实上，除了从游戏和漫画中学到的东西，他从未与女性有过任何交往经验。尽管缺乏现实经验，Souta还是答应帮忙，没想到事情的发展出乎意料。
